name: Hodge 6 (Hubble)
blurb: Hodge 6, an intermediate-age star cluster in the Large Magellanic Cloud, seen by Hubble.
label: h6-hubble
story: Hodge 6 is an intermediate-age star cluster in the Large Magellanic Cloud, a satellite galaxy of the Milky Way. Its turnoff looked simple to Hubble, yet spectra later found a few stars enriched in nitrogen, a sign that even this cluster holds more than one generation of stars.

claims.text: Hodge 6 is a cluster in the Large Magellanic Cloud
Hodge 6 was a target of program 12257 on Magellanic Cloud star clusters
The Large Magellanic Cloud is a satellite galaxy of the Milky Way
Such clusters challenge the idea of simple stellar populations
Hodge 6 is an intermediate-age LMC cluster
Hodge 6 lacked clear evidence of an extended turnoff in a later sample
Spectra found nitrogen-enriched stars in Hodge 6, evidence of multiple populations
